audience: theatre and arts venue staff who sell tickets and memberships in Spektrix

useCases.title: See what is on sale in the next 30 days
useCases.text: List the events that are on sale for a short date range. List the performances across events for the same dates.

useCases.title: Review the performances of one event
useCases.text: Find an event by name, then list its performances between two dates with their start times and on-sale status.

useCases.title: Track orders changed since a given time
useCases.text: List the confirmed orders changed since a time you choose, oldest first. Read the tickets, seats, performances and totals of each order. Spektrix must enable this sync for your system first.

useCases.title: Review the memberships your system sells
useCases.text: List the memberships your Spektrix system sells, with their names and descriptions.
